_comment: Golden labels for the 10 liva-ai/mock-sales calls. DRAFT: written by Claude from reading the reference transcripts, so objective fields only. A human must review before these are treated as ground truth. null = not labelled. Subjective counts (pitch/close attempts) are deliberately left unlabelled for a human.
_how_to_review: For each call: check seller_ref_speaker, outcome_ok, and the pricing numbers against the reference transcript in data/reference/train.jsonl. Add pitch_attempts / close_attempts when you have counted them.
